Competition Name: Video News Production (formerly Broadcast News Production)
Description of Event: This contest is open to active SkillsUSA members enrolled in Career and Technical Education (CTE) with media technology and/or news broadcasting programs. This contest has a team of four student members; two students serve as the news anchor team, one student will serve as the team’s director/technical director and one student will serve as the floor director. Each team will prepare a news rundown, write, produce and perform a three-minute newscast as if it were live. Teams are evaluated on their news writing ability, voice quality, diction, timing, direction, pacing and on-camera performance techniques.
